name: eliviz
description: Eliviz — data files to single-file interactive HTML experiences with switchable design identities.

plugins.name: eliviz
plugins.description: Turn any data file (CSV, Excel, SQLite, JSON/JSONL, Markdown, logs) into a single-file interactive HTML experience, with a five-style design bank and a design-adapter agent that crafts custom/blended styles on demand.
